glossary.simpleEnglish: A compact coastal training ground where new heroes learn every system of the game before tackling larger campaigns.
glossary.explanation: A compact coastal training ground where new heroes learn every system of the game before tackling larger campaigns.

glossary.simpleEnglish: The cliffside signal brazier lit at the end of the tutorial trials to mark a recruit's graduation.
glossary.explanation: The cliffside signal brazier lit at the end of the tutorial trials to mark a recruit's graduation.

glossary.simpleEnglish: Crafting where you select a general item type and primary materials, discovering the exact forged item upon completion.
glossary.explanation: Crafting where you select a general item type and primary materials, discovering the exact forged item upon completion.

glossary.simpleEnglish: Combining two items directly in Inventory to hone weapons, apply temporary elemental coatings, or brew supplies.
glossary.explanation: Combining two items directly in Inventory to hone weapons, apply temporary elemental coatings, or brew supplies.

glossary.simpleEnglish: Combat rows: melee attacks must clear frontline enemies before reaching backline foes, while ranged attacks and certain spells can bypass the front row.
glossary.explanation: Combat rows: melee attacks must clear frontline enemies before reaching backline foes, while ranged attacks and certain spells can bypass the front row.

glossary.simpleEnglish: Points earned from skill milestones that unlock new spells in the Character Grimoire, usable in combat up to your per-fight casting capacity.
glossary.explanation: Points earned from skill milestones that unlock new spells in the Character Grimoire, usable in combat up to your per-fight casting capacity.

glossary.simpleEnglish: Concealed caches discovered by using Search Area at a location; they often hold rare materials or trigger secret Hidden Missions.
glossary.explanation: Concealed caches discovered by using Search Area at a location; they often hold rare materials or trigger secret Hidden Missions.

glossary.simpleEnglish: Common coastal crafting reagents gathered in Whispering Grove or bought from Quartermaster Sera.
glossary.explanation: Common coastal crafting reagents gathered in Whispering Grove or bought from Quartermaster Sera.
